notes: Seal of Fury, Holy Shield on cooldown, Holy Strike, Hammer of the Righteous and Judgement, with Consecration only on spare mana and the three defensives on low health. Righteous Fury is not a line: it is a request option (PaladinOptions.righteousFury), worth +60 percent threat on Holy damage and, with Improved Righteous Fury, up to 6 percent less damage taken. Devotion Aura is not a line either: the kit keeps it on (sim/leveling/kit.go), as the Protection paladin's own armor aura; Blessing of Sanctuary is not in this client. Judgement no longer consumes the seal in Forever (Blizzard's Deep Dive recap), so Seal of Fury is recast every 30 seconds rather than after each Judgement. Mana is the limiter, so every other spell leaves Holy Shield's cost (240 mana at rank 3) in the pool: Holy Shield is both the best mitigation and the best use of mana. Holy Strike sits straight after Holy Shield because, with Iron Creed (in the guide build), it is mitigation as well as threat: while Righteous Fury is on it cuts the damage taken for 6 of every 10 seconds. Measured by hand on the engine's tank fight (spec-breakdown -tank with the published level 60 raid-ready set against the curated boss, 10,000 iterations; rotation-search scores damage only and skips tank specs), each line against the same rotation without it: Holy Shield 6 percent more damage taken and 21 percent less threat without it, Holy Strike 4 percent more damage taken and 7 percent less threat, Hammer of the Righteous 17 percent less threat, Consecration 12 percent less threat, Judgement 7 percent less threat. Moving Holy Strike ahead of Holy Shield, Hammer ahead of Holy Strike, Judgement ahead of Hammer, or Consecration's mana floor between 30 and 80 percent, moved nothing past the noise. The defensives on health (Templar's Bulwark below 35, Divine Shield below 25, Divine Protection below 20 percent) cut the chance of death on a boss that hits harder than the published one and rarely fire on it. Unconfirmed, and moving this list: Improved Seal of Fury's mana (the client prints 0, the engine assumes 1 percent of maximum mana a spent shield), Hammer of the Righteous as 3 times the main hand weapon's damage per second (the client's text; whether attack power counts is not stated), Consecration's damage as the client's companion rows state it (12 a second to everything in the area and 27 more to the first four, 0.095 spell power on the extra), and Divine Protection and Divine Shield under their Classic Era ids.

priorityList.notes: Lay on Hands is the survival cooldown of last resort and fires itself below 10 percent health.

Templar's Bulwark, an absorb of the paladin's whole health bar for 8 seconds, as the first panic button: low health is when a late shield buys the most, and it puts Forbearance on the next two defensives for a minute.
Divine Shield: 12 seconds of immunity at half damage dealt, the second panic button once Forbearance from the first has gone.
Divine Protection: 8 seconds of immunity with no attacks, the last resort.
Seal of Fury kept up. Judgement no longer consumes the seal in Forever, so this recasts every 30 seconds, and only with Holy Shield's mana left over.
Holy Shield on cooldown: its 10 second cooldown equals its duration, so it is up whenever its four charges last, and it is the first claim on mana.
Holy Strike on cooldown: the cheapest threat per mana the paladin has (20 mana).
Hammer of the Righteous on cooldown, once the Holy Shield mana is safe.
Swift Judgement while Judgement is on cooldown: it finishes the cooldown and makes the next Judgement free, one more Judgement a minute.
Judgement on cooldown (an off-the-global cast of 6 percent of base mana).
Exorcism on Undead and Demons only; the engine refuses it on any other target.
Consecration last and only above half mana: about one threat per mana against ten for Hammer of the Righteous, so it is the use of mana the tank has to spare.

expected_idle.reason: Holy Shield needs a shield and the ladder's character carries none (a paladin's off hand is a weapon slot only for dual-wielding classes), so the engine refuses the cast at every level. A tank in the tank fight, shield on, casts it every 10 seconds.

Exorcism only lands on Undead or Demon (sim/paladin/exorcism.go's ExtraCastCondition); the published tank boss, like the ladder's target, has no creature type, so this line's gate structurally can never pass against it.
